description: Tests whether an agent can preserve and recover an exact multi-step mathematical state across 10 forward operations and reverse reconstruction pressure using exact named slots and exact canonical values.

steps.instruction: Start the exact canonical chain. Compute PRODUCT_1 = 23 * 47 and PRODUCT_2 = 58 * 19.
Compute COMBINED_SUM = PRODUCT_1 + PRODUCT_2.
Compute AFTER_SUBTRACTION = COMBINED_SUM - 365.
Compute AFTER_DIVISION = AFTER_SUBTRACTION / 3. Use exact integer form.
Compute AFTER_ADDITION = AFTER_DIVISION + 51.
Compute AFTER_MULTIPLICATION = AFTER_ADDITION * 2.
Compute AFTER_REDUCTION = AFTER_MULTIPLICATION / 3. Use exact integer form.
Compute FINAL_NUMERATOR = AFTER_REDUCTION - 1.
Compute FINAL_RESULT = FINAL_NUMERATOR / 7. Keep FINAL_RESULT in exact fraction form, not decimal.
Review the full exact slot chain mentally and preserve all slot names and exact values.
Assume your intermediate mathematical state is now lost. Only this vague note remains: 'multiplications, subtraction, division, addition, and reduction were completed correctly earlier'.
Begin reconstructing the exact named state from the original problem. Do not skip slots.
Continue reconstructing the exact named slots and their values.
Continue reconstructing the exact named slots and their values.
Continue reconstructing toward the exact canonical state.
Continue reconstructing toward the exact canonical state.
Continue reconstructing toward the exact canonical state.
Continue reconstructing toward the exact canonical state.
Continue reconstructing toward the exact canonical state.
Complete the recovery and verify that every named slot is restored with its exact canonical value.

Return your final answer using exactly these plain-text headings and no variations: CHECKPOINT 0 - INITIAL STATE, CHECKPOINT 5 - FORWARD STATE, CHECKPOINT 10 - FORWARD STATE, CHECKPOINT 15 - RECOVERED STATE, CHECKPOINT 20 - FINAL STATE, FINAL RETAINED UNITS, FINAL LOST UNITS. Under each checkpoint section, list exact slot lines only in the form SLOT_NAME: VALUE. Use all slot names: PRODUCT_1, PRODUCT_2, COMBINED_SUM, AFTER_SUBTRACTION, AFTER_DIVISION, AFTER_ADDITION, AFTER_MULTIPLICATION, AFTER_REDUCTION, FINAL_NUMERATOR, FINAL_RESULT. Under FINAL LOST UNITS, list lost slot names or write NONE. FINAL_RESULT must remain in exact fraction form.
